name: Hensel FP_TS_38 mounting-rail component
summary: FP_TS_38 mounting-rail component arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: FP_TS_38 is the drawing identifier for mounting-rail component in Hensel's ENYSTAR enclosure and distribution-system STEP collection. A mounting-rail component supports compatible panel devices. The rail profile, mounting method and load support must be selected for the actual equipment arrangement.

For example, in a control-panel mounting plate carrying modular devices, use the FP_TS_38 reference to coordinate rail fixing points, device attachment and release access. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as ENYSTAR_Tragschienen/FP_TS_38.stp for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep rail fixing points, device attachment and release access visible in the layout.

This reference concerns the named FP_TS_38 drawing and its mounting-rail component role. A drawing in the same collection is not automatic evidence of compatible terminals, mounts or electrical performance.
drawingChecklist: Match FP_TS_38, the native drawing identity and the project equipment schedule.
Coordinate fixing locations and equipment removal rather than drawing an unsupported line.
Coordinate rail fixing points, device attachment and release access with neighbouring equipment.
